reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her direct message thread. There's no written escalation path or phone list for Quarrendon Freight Lines in anything she can see, so the answer is based on how the last outage was handled:

- **Internally, call Ilse Varga** (North team lead, ivarga@pemberline.com). In the last serious outage on this account (#inc-qfl-sev1, 4 Nov 2025), Ilse brought in the on-call engineer, Samir Patel. Samir is only listed as a guest in the directory, so I can't confirm he's still on call. I told Dana to ask Ilse who's on call today.
- **On the customer side, call Thea Ramaswell**, their Director of Yard Operations. She's the main contact listed in the North team notes and joined the call during the last outage.

I also told Dana that:
- I don't have phone numbers for Ilse or Thea.
- #inc-qfl-sev1 is still there if this is an outage and she wants to use it again.
- "Quarendon Freightways" (one R) is a different company and not a customer.
- I can draft a note to Ilse if she'd like.

I only read channels Dana is in and files she can open.
